title: serving-runtime-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-15
content:
2026-03-15 - daily scratchpad (serving-runtime)

Context:
- Quick personal notes for bug triage and perf TODOs. Mostly notes-to-self, small experiments, and followups.

Top priorities:
1) Debug GH#987 (attention kernel fallback) - high impact on long sequences (seq_len > 4096).
   - Symptoms: sudden 5-15% latency spike at rollout when sequence length distribution shifts. CPU fallback to slower kernel observed.
   - Repro steps: run perf test with seq=512/1024/2048/8192 on latest kernel branch (w/ nvfuser/triton toggles).
   - Short-term mitigation: add model-routing rule to pin to attention-optimized variant for sessions with long prefixes.

2) Perf regression after quantization experiment (4-bit PTQ) - small quality loss, big cost win.
   - Eval on evalset-A: baseline perplexity 12.8, 4-bit PTQ -> 13.0 (approx +1.56%); need to confirm on evalset-B.
   - Throughput on A100: baseline fp16 = ~1200 tok/s, 4-bit = ~1850 tok/s (w/ new GEMM kernel). Confirm memory and caching behavior.
   - Action: run accuracy sweep on 3 seed drops, log results to JIRA-INF-612, add to Optimize cohort.

3) KV cache hit-rate telemetry inconsistency on Dedicated nodes.
   - Dashboard shows occasional 0% kv hits for multi-turn flows -> likely mismatched session IDs / routing.
   - TODO: add session trace id to routing header, correlate with trace spans (console request-id).

Notes / triage list:
- GH#987 (attention kernel): traced to kernel_select() path - fallback condition at line 214 (attention.cu). Suspect gating: if (seq_len * head_dim > KERNEL_LIMIT) fallback. Need to check if KERNEL_LIMIT calibrated per-device.
- GH#994: nvfuser crashes under heavy batching with torch.compile=true. Repro with batch sizes [8,16,32] and sequence length 1024.
- JIRA-INF-598: scheduled rolling restart causing cold kv-cache losses on Dedicated; check autoscaler drain lifecycle.

Microbenchmarks (local workstation w/ A100 40GB):
- fp16 baseline (serving-runtime v2.3.1): 128 token prompt, batch=8 -> 1180 tok/s avg (std 45)
- 4-bit PTQ (w/ new-gemm): 128 token prompt, batch=8 -> 1820 tok/s avg (std 120)
- attention-optimized kernel: seq=8192 fallback present; with experimental patch (branch kernel-fix/attn-limit) no fallback observed up to seq=12288 in microbench. Must validate on multi-tenant infra.

Kernel notes (ideas & todos):
- Re-evaluate KERNEL_LIMIT heuristic: should be per-GPU (A100 vs H100), consider dynamic calibration at startup using a tiny profiler.
- Add a runtime feature flag: RDW_KERNEL_DYNAMIC_LIMIT=true to enable auto-calibration.
- Check Triton kernel parameterization for head_dim=64 vs 128; current kernels only tuned for 64 -> suboptimal for some open models.
- Investigate mixed-precision kernel stability: nvfuser + triton combo shows non-deterministic speed on H100 under heavy IO.

Quick commands to repro locally:
- attention fallback repro:
  ./scripts/run_microbench.sh --model redwood/open-llama-13b --seq 8192 --batch 1 --profile kernels
- nvfuser crash repro:
  python -m perf.bench --model redwood/roberta-xxl --batch 16 --seq 1024 --torch-compile true --log-level debug

Followups / action items:
- [ ] Run 3-seed accuracy sweep for 4-bit PTQ (Maya to help with eval harness) - target by 2026-03-18.
- [ ] Merge kernel-fix/attn-limit after infra canary (Elias to own canary).
- [ ] Add session-id header & trace correlation to kv cache metrics (me).
- [ ] Add unit test to prevent attention fallback regression (create synthetic long-seq test).

Quick thoughts / notes to self:
- When adding dynamic KERNEL_LIMIT, ensure not to regress cold-start latency (calib step must be async or very fast).
- Consider adding a per-model config override in catalog for "max_safe_seq" to avoid global heuristics.
- If 4-bit PTQ quality variance too high on evalset-B, explore layerwise finer-grain QAT on top of PTQ.

Meeting notes (sync w/ Maya/Elias 2026-03-15 14:00):
- Confirm canary plan for kernel patch (canary in us-west1, 2 nodes, monitoring latency & error-rate); rollback window 30m.
- Agree to hold Dedicated infra restarts until kv-cache tracing in Prod is validated.

Logs / snippets (copied):
- profiler output sample:
  Attention kernel choose: triton_attn_v2 (seq=512, head_dim=64) -> 0.9ms
  Attention kernel fallback: fallback_sparse_attn (seq=8192) -> 9.2ms

Random TODOs (low priority):
- Improve perf dashboard labels for "kernel_variant" (right now too many synonyms).
- Clean up old branches: kernel-experiments-2025 (ask release-eng).

End of scratchpad.

-- Daniel
